gloss.en: The root عنكب (Enkb) primarily refers to the spider (عَنْكَبُوتٌ), an insect known for weaving delicate webs. The word can be masculine or feminine, and has several plural forms.
gloss.short: The root عنكب (Enkb) primarily refers to the spider (عَنْكَبُوتٌ), an insect known for weaving delicate webs.
